summary: Checkpoint D independent verification of the offer-letter QR bug (user-reported: PDFs said 'your secure candidate portal' but embedded no QR). Wrote a 17-test suite exercising (A) offline _generate_offer_pdf across all 5 variants — 'SCAN TO ACCEPT' present on original, 'SCAN TO VIEW' on accepted, ABSENT on rescinded/expired/declined; (B) portal_url selection (public_confirm_url wins, env-fallback used from candidate_token, legacy `public_token` field ignored, no QR when neither is present); (C) E2E ordering fix via real HTTP flow — POST /offers/draft → POST /offers/{id}/send → GET /offers/{id}/pdf; downloaded PDF text extracted with PyMuPDF asserts 'SCAN TO ACCEPT' present on the FIRST-sent letter (ordering fix verified); (D) public candidate portal regression — GET /public/{token} returns 404 for invalid tokens, accept enforces ack + non-empty signed_name, decline works. Frontend page /careers/offer/confirm loads without auth and shows correct 'Missing token' / 'Offer link invalid or expired' states. All existing offer regression suites still green (63 passed, 1 skipped — unchanged from iter876 baseline). Combined run: 80 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed. Cleanup verified — 0 iter877 or review-sample records left in DB.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/careers_offers.py:975-980 — portal_url = offer.get('public_confirm_url') or env-fallback(FRONTEND_BASE_URL|REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL)+/careers/offer/confirm?token=. Robust: neither field alone forces the QR — both are checked, and the SCAN label is only drawn for variants in ('original','accepted'). Verified across 17 test cases including a negative test with the OLD buggy field name 'public_token'.

routes/careers_offers.py:1462-1464 — admin_send_offer builds offer_for_pdf = {**offer, expires_at, candidate_token, public_confirm_url} BEFORE calling _generate_offer_pdf and BEFORE the update_one persist. This is the ordering fix. E2E test (TestOrderingFixE2E) confirms the FIRST persisted PDF served by GET /offers/{id}/pdf carries 'SCAN TO ACCEPT'.

test_offer_letter_pro_pdf.py fixtures 131/206/346 correctly use `candidate_token` (previously 'public_token' which had masked the bug). Old field name is now non-functional at runtime — verified by TestOldBuggyFieldIgnored.test_legacy_public_token_field_does_not_trigger_qr.

Public accept/decline endpoints correctly enforce CSRF (X-Requested-With header required). This is intentional. The candidate-portal frontend page adds this header via the fetch wrapper. Tests updated to include the header.
Consider adding a data-testid to the /careers/offer/confirm error state ('Link unavailable') for future E2E robustness — not blocking.

rca_of_the_issue: Two independent defects made the QR silently vanish on production offer letters: (1) The PDF renderer checked `offer.get('public_token')` — a field name that is never persisted anywhere in the codebase (real fields are `candidate_token` and `public_confirm_url` written by admin_send_offer at ~line 1481-1482). The QR condition was therefore falsy for every real offer. (2) Even after fixing #1, admin_send_offer's original code path called _generate_offer_pdf BEFORE inserting candidate_token into offer_for_pdf, so the first-sent letter still could not embed a QR. Tests didn't catch this because fixtures set the wrong 'public_token' field — the same wrong name the buggy renderer accepted, masking the bug in both places simultaneously. Main agent's fix: (a) renderer now consults `public_confirm_url` then falls back to composing from `candidate_token` + FRONTEND_BASE_URL/REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; (b) admin_send_offer builds offer_for_pdf = {**offer, expires_at, candidate_token, public_confirm_url} before rendering; (c) fixtures migrated to `candidate_token`. This iter877 suite adds an explicit regression guard (TestOldBuggyFieldIgnored) that renders a PDF with only the legacy `public_token` set and asserts NO QR appears, so the old masked pattern cannot re-emerge.
